name: Like Water (Combat)
body:
You have honed your reflexes to the point of instinct.

Prerequisite(s): Evasion, Improved Unarmed Strike, Acrobatics 9 ranks

Benefit(s): When fighting defensively you gain a +4 dodge bonus to AC and suffer only a -2 penalty to attack rolls. Additionally, when an opponent misses you while you are fighting defensively or taking the total defense action you may make an attack of opportunity with an unarmed strike or light weapon.
